package.description: State-based schema deployment for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB.

en-US.description: State-based schema deployment for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB.
en-US.longDescription: SchemaSmith is a state-based database schema deployment toolset. Declare your schema as JSON and SchemaQuench converges any target to match it; SchemaTongs extracts an existing database to that JSON; DataTongs manages reference data. Works across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB.
en-US.name: SchemaSmith
